execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."architecture" (
  "createdAt" text NOT NULL,
  "environmentId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."architectureConnection" (
  "architectureId" text NOT NULL,
  "edgeType" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "label" text,
  "sourceId" text NOT NULL,
  "targetId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."architectureResource" (
  "architectureId" text NOT NULL,
  "configJson" text NOT NULL,
  "groupId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "label" text NOT NULL,
  "locked" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "positionX" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "positionY" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "provider" text NOT NULL,
  "region" text,
  "resourceType" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."architectureVersion" (
  "architectureId" text NOT NULL,
  "author" text DEFAULT 'Unknown' NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "label" text NOT NULL,
  "projectId" text NOT NULL,
  "snapshotJson" text NOT NULL,
  "summary" text NOT NULL,
  "versionNumber" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."environment" (
  "createdAt" text NOT NULL,
  "envKey" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "label" text NOT NULL,
  "projectId" text NOT NULL,
  "region" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."orgMember" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "orgId" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'member' NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."organization" (
  "createdAt" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."project" (
  "createdAt" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "orgId" text NOT NULL,
  "ownerId" text NOT NULL,
  "provider" text NOT NULL,
  "region" text NOT NULL,
  "tags" text DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "avatarUrl" text,
  "createdAt" text NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text,
  "updatedAt" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
